title: Founding SDR | Outbound Sales Development Representative | DACH (m/w/d)
description:
Bei Superchat gestalten wir neu, wie Unternehmen mit ihren Kund:innen kommunizieren. KI wird dabei immer mehr zum Motor dieser Kommunikation. Integrationen sind das, was diesem Motor echte Power gibt: die Daten, Tools und Systeme, die aus einem cleveren AI-Agenten einen machen, der Prozesse wirklich automatisiert und Probleme löst.

Gegründet im Jahr 2020, ist Superchat heute die Plattform für über 10.000 Unternehmen weltweit - von bekannten Marken wie Allianz, Auto1, Enpal, Danone und GASAG bis hin zu kleinen Unternehmen, Zahnarztpraxen und Solo-Founder:innen, die professioneller auftreten möchten.

Inzwischen laufen täglich Millionen von Nachrichten über Superchat.

Gestartet sind wir als Unified Inbox - ein zentraler Ort für alle Kommunikationskanäle wie WhatsApp, E-Mail, SMS oder Instagram. Mit dem Aufstieg von ChatGPT begann unser nächstes Kapitel: AI Agents, die über Chat, E-Mail und Voice in einer Qualität kommunizieren, die mit den besten menschlichen Teams mithalten kann.

Heute sind wir ein Team von rund 100 Mitarbeitenden , arbeiten profitabel und haben insgesamt 18 Millionen Euro Funding eingesammelt (unsere letzte Finanzierungsrunde liegt bereits 4,5 Jahre zurück - seitdem wachsen wir aus eigener Kraft weiter).

Unser Hauptsitz ist in Berlin.

Superchat ist mit über 10.000 Kunden stark über Inbound gewachsen. Inbound bleibt unser Fundament, jetzt kommt Outbound dazu. Dafür bauen wir ein eigenes Team auf, und du bist einer unserer ersten beiden Outbound-SDRs: ein echter Founding Hire.

Deine Basis ist das Telefon. Du führst jeden Tag viele Cold Calls mit Mittelstands- und Enterprise-Unternehmen in der DACH-Region und öffnest Türen zu Geschäftsführer:innen, Vertriebs- und Serviceleitungen. Dazu kommt der Aufbau: Du testest neue Verticals, recherchierst Listen, entwickelst Playbooks und setzt eigene Kampagnenideen um. Was funktioniert, wird zur Blaupause für das Team, das nach dir kommt.

Dein Ziel: qualifizierte Demos für unsere Account Executives. Jede Demo, die du buchst, und jeder Deal, der daraus entsteht, zahlt sich für dich direkt aus.

Who We Want

Cold Call Lover.
Du greifst gern zum Hörer, und ein hohes Call-Volumen jeden Tag macht dir Spaß

Hunter.
Du willst nicht verwalten, sondern jagen: neue Accounts öffnen, Gespräche starten, Pipeline aus dem Nichts aufbauen

Native-Level German.
Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und triffst den Ton, vom Mittelständler bis zur Konzern-Geschäftsführung

Self-Starter.
Du siehst eine Chance in einem neuen Vertical und testest sie, statt auf einen Auftrag zu warten

Resilient & Hungry to Learn.
Ein „Nein“ ist für dich nur der Anfang, du hörst deine Calls nach und wirst jede Woche besser

Sales Starter.
Du stehst am Berufsanfang oder hast erste Erfahrung in der Kaltakquise, wichtig sind Drive und Lernkurve

Who We Don't Want

Inbound Waiter.
Du wartest lieber auf eingehende Leads, statt selbst rauszugehen

Call-Shy.
Du schreibst lieber E-Mails, als zum Hörer zu greifen

Script Reader.
Du liest stur dein Skript ab, statt echte Gespräche zu führen

Feedback-Averse.
Du siehst Feedback als Kritik statt als Chance, dich weiterzuentwickeln

Your Day to Day 

Cold Calling & Demo-Booking (~65 %)

• Du führst jeden Tag Cold Calls und bist unsere stärkste Stimme am Telefon

• Du qualifizierst im Gespräch, ob Superchat der richtige Fit ist, und buchst Demos für unsere Account Executives

• Du fasst per E-Mail und LinkedIn nach und sprichst pro Account mehrere Entscheider:innen an

Kampagnen & Playbooks (~25 %)

• Du recherchierst Accounts und Kontakte und baust Listen nach unserem Ideal Customer Profile

• Du setzt Sequenzen in lemlist auf, testest neue Verticals und setzt eigene Kampagnenideen um

• Du entwickelst Call-Skripte, Einwandbehandlung und Playbooks, die das Team übernimmt

Lernen & Optimieren (~10 %)

• Du wertest deine Zahlen aus und hältst fest, was funktioniert

• Du tauschst dich eng mit den AEs aus und bringst Feedback aus dem Mark

Solid experience with Microsoft Office Suite is necessary, especially with Outlook, Excel, Teams, and One Note as well as experience using a clinical documentation software program.

title: Product Manager, Developer Tools & Compiler
description:
About IonQ: 

IonQ, Inc . [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance .

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.  

We are looking for a technical, detail-oriented Product Manager to own the product backlog for IonQ's developer tools and compiler. This includes our SDK, compilation and optimization toolchain, simulators, and integrations with popular quantum frameworks. You'll be part of IonQ's Compute Product Management team. You'll embed with the engineering teams that build these tools and help turn strategy into clear, prioritized, buildable work.

In this role, you'll be the day-to-day product partner for engineering. You'll translate developer and customer needs into well-defined requirements, set and defend priorities, write acceptance criteria that make "done" clear, and make sure what ships solves real user problems. You'll work closely with Engineering, Developer Experience, Applications Research, and Customer Success to shape how researchers and developers build on IonQ hardware.

You don't need a background in quantum computing. You DO need a strong technical foundation, real empathy for developers, and the discipline to turn ambiguous problems into precise, testable requirements. This role suits someone who is curious, comfortable in fast-moving technical discussions, and motivated by seeing their work show up in the tools developers use every day.

If you're passionate about developer tools and excited to help shape how the world programs quantum computers, we'd love to hear from you.

Responsibilities:

• Prioritize the Backlog: Own and maintain a prioritized backlog of features, improvements and bug fixes. Weigh user impact, business value, technical effort and dependencies. Make clear tradeoff calls and explain the reasoning to engineering and stakeholders.

• Define Requirements & Acceptance Criteria: Turn user needs, customer feedback and roadmap goals into clear product requirements and user stories with actionable, defined goals. Work with engineering and QA to confirm what ships meets those goals.

• Understand the Technology: Learn IonQ's compiler, gate sets, simulation and SDK architecture well enough to take part in technical tradeoff discussions. Know where compiler performance, circuit fidelity and developer usability pull against each other.

• Partner with Engineering: Embed with the developer tools and compiler engineering teams as their primary product counterpart. Join sprint planning, backlog grooming, design reviews and standups. Be available to answer product questions quickly so the team keeps moving.

• Ship and Iterate: Shepherd features from definition through release. Coordinate release notes, documentation and enablement with Developer Experience. Measure adoption and quality after launch, and feed what you learn back into the backlog.

•

Regulatory compliance and technical documentation: Prepare clear, traceable, technically rigorous, and defensible analyses suitable for federal environmental review records, licensing proceedings, and rulemaking activities.

title: Director of Development
description:
About Young Americans For Liberty

Founded after the 2008 Ron Paul Presidential Campaign, Young Americans for Liberty (YAL) is the nation’s largest pro-liberty youth movement, building a powerful network of activists to transform states into beacons of freedom.

We drive real change in America by working through our "Build - Elect - Pass" model:

•
Build: We are building the largest nationwide movement of committed youth activists on American college campuses, with pro-liberty students fighting on hundreds of campuses across the country.

•
Elect: We mobilize our base of committed youth activists to be the grassroots muscle on campaigns of principled liberty legislators through Operation Win at the Door. Since 2018, we've built a coalition of 400 active legislators in our National Liberty Legislator Coalition, and thousands of YAL-recruited students have knocked on over 6 million doors to turn out the vote.

•
Pass: We train this coalition of principled liberty legislators to pass transformative policy at the state level. This coalition has already passed over 1,250 pro-liberty bills spanning from Universal School Choice, to Constitutional Carry, to major tax cuts and so much more. You can view the full list of bills passed at.

Mission & Vision

Our mission is to identify, educate, train, and mobilize youth activists committed to the ideals of liberty and the Constitution. Our vision is to create Liberty Lighthouse States that will Transform Our States into Beacons of Liberty. YAL also works to achieve this vision by electing liberty legislators and passing liberty legislation.

Our Values & Culture

YAL's culture is built on 5 foundational values:

•
Goal Setting: We orient our work towards specific goals that align with achieving our long-term vision.

•
Trust the Truth: We pursue the truth and are honest in all we do, even when it’s difficult. There should never be a situation where lying is the right answer if we’re truthful from the beginning.

•
Grassroots Mobilization: We win on principle by generating grassroots pressure on the politicians. Unless you are politically feared, you will not be politically respected. Education alone is not enough.

•
Principle: We believe in liberty - which provides the freedom to choose and requires taking responsibility for your choices - and individual rights - which must be respected at all times.

•
Power of the Individual: We recognize everyone has an innate ability to make a difference. Therefore, we are dedicated to aligning your goals and developing your strengths so you can unlock your full potential.

Candidates who will fit in with YAL's culture tend to be principled, entrepreneurial, passionate, and comfortable with ambitious goals and a fast-paced work environment.

Think you can lead a high-performing team to raise millions for liberty?

Young Americans for Liberty has an ambitious goal to raise $150 million across the liberty movement by 2030. To get there, we need a Director of Development who can bring out the best in our people and keep our fundraising efforts running at a high level.

We're looking for a proven manager who knows how to set high standards, solve problems, and turn plans into results. Someone who enjoys developing talent, digging into data, and holding people accountable.

If you're ready to take ownership of a demanding leadership role where your work directly supports the fight for liberty, we want to hear from you.

About the role

The Director of Development manages the day-to-day operations and staff of YAL's Development Department, supporting both Young Americans for Liberty and the Young Americans for Liberty Foundation.

You'll oversee fundraising processes, monitor donor portfolios, and use data to identify opportunities for improvement. You'll also work directly with our CEO and COO to coordinate their donor activity, prepare for meetings, and ensure commitments are completed.

You can look at all kinds of communities to see our platform’s impact in the world. It's the retailer that uses our agentic AI to deter theft before it happens. The warehouse that uses AI-powered alerts to make sure its team is protected on the floor with proper PPE. The school that’s alerted to a threat in real-time and triggers a lockdown in seconds, not minutes. Whether you need to get into a building, drop off a package, ask about store hours or get help in an emergency, the intercom is how you reach a person who can help.

Calling is at the heart of the Intercom experience, and we need a product manager to own it end to end: every call, from the moment someone presses the button to the moment someone answers and helps them.

description:

About BOI
BOI is the AI partner that Walmart, Coca-Cola, and Mastercard call when AI needs to drive growth, not just savings. We rebuild how work gets done, starting from the outcomes each team exists to deliver: agents do the work, people own the judgment, and the capacity it frees goes to growth. We bring together the unusually strong in frontier enterprise AI, then give them the ownership to make it happen. If you're looking for a comfortable place to hide, we're not it. If you want to build the future of enterprise AI with people who will make you better: welcome home.
Your Role
Own the Technical Build

• Own the architecture and engineering quality of every client build, from first prototype to production in the client's environment.

• Shape solution architecture across models, clouds and platforms, and make build, buy or configure calls you can defend to a client CTO. Our clients run on Azure, AWS and Google Cloud. We're independent of every vendor, so the answer is whatever is best for the client.

Lead with Clients

• Turn what we've built into case studies, reusable IP and technical thought leadership.

Build the Team

• Lead, coach and grow our engineering team, roughly doubling it over the next year. Set high standards, give direct feedback, and give credit generously.

• Run AI-first ways of working across engineering, with your own tools and workflows as the example.

• Help build BOI like an owner, alongside our leadership team in the US and Europe.

What We Look For
We are deliberately not for everyone. We look for a specific combination of qualities:

• You've shipped AI systems to production at enterprise scale, inside environments with real security, compliance and data constraints.

• You've led engineering in a consultancy, agency or other project-based environment. You're comfortable with work that changes shape every few months and with stacks you didn't choose.

• You've founded a company or been early at a startup. You can build the team as well as the system, and you make good decisions before everything is known.

• You explain technical choices to non-technical executives in plain language, and they leave the room ready to decide.

What We Offer

• You'll set the technical direction of a growing AI company and shape how BOI builds in every market we work in.

• You'll build compounding skills at the frontier of AI while others are still catching up.

• What your team builds goes live in client systems within weeks, and you see the value it creates.

• We're independent of every vendor, so you work across every model and cloud, building with whatever is best and swapping it when something better ships.

• You get the freedom to prototype, experiment, and push boundaries on what's possible with AI.

Benefits
We also offer comprehensive health benefits, 401(k), 25 days PTO, hybrid working (if based out of NYC), professional development support, and the opportunity to work alongside some of the world's leading AI practitioners on high-impact enterprise transformations.

title: Senior Product Analyst, Unit Economics
description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

Relay delivers 400,000 parcels a day through people who don't work for us: van drivers who choose their own shifts, local shops that hold parcels, and couriers who take them to the door. We went from 3,000 parcels a day in London to 400,000 across the UK in under three years.

Most delivery companies sell on price and volume, and find out later whether a client made them money. Sales teams are measured on what they sign, not on what a signing is worth. Relay wants every client, and every new shop in the network, to be one we'd choose again.

That is harder for us than for most, because what a client is worth depends on how their parcels flow through a network that's still growing. Engineering and analytics engineering build what you design.

SALES HIGHLIGHTS

- You own decision-making, not the model: you decide what a client or shop is worth and which signings sales should chase. The sales lead acts on your calls.

- What is a new client or a new shop worth, when its value depends on where it sits in a network that changes every month? What would you build so sales knows before it signs?

- Which signings become partners who do well with us, and what does that tell sales to look for?

- The quarter's target is set. What has to close by when for it to hold, and what would tell you early that it won't?

- A whole area, not a slice: you decide how sales values what it wins, and the result shows in what we sign next.

- Analytics at the front, not in support: the squad's roadmap follows the analysis, in a data team of about 30 across analytics, operational research and data science.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As a Senior Product Analyst, Unit Economics at Relay, you'll:

- Decide which Sales problems are real and which only look real, before anyone builds a fix.

- Design how Sales decides: which signals count, what a client or shop is worth, and what good looks like.

- Tell the sales lead what to change and what to stop, and get a decision.

- Build the thing that decides: data applications, monitors and alerts, not decks, using Claude and agents to ship your own tools.

- Go and look when the numbers and the street disagree: a new shop, a client's parcels at the sort centre.

- Get the missing data built, and prove whether each change worked. In a year, sales chooses what to go after on measures you built, and can see whether the quarter will land before it ends.

WE'RE LOOKING FOR CANDIDATES WHO…

- Have owned B2B pricing or commercial decisions and their number, rather than maintaining sales dashboards.

- Have built, hands on, the first version of how a company values a customer or a deal: unit economics, lifetime value, or what it costs to win one.

- Have seen their work acted on: a leader changed a plan, a team adopted your method, or sales went after different deals because of it.

- Have got records created by teams who didn't report to you, and know how long it takes.

- Can say early whethe

title: Account Executive - Partnership Focus
description:
Location: Remote (preference for West Coast or tech hubs like Austin, Denver, Seattle, or San Francisco)
About NextLink Labs

NextLink Labs is a technical consulting firm that helps companies build, scale, and secure their technology through custom software development, DevOps, and application security services.
We work with startups and public companies, especially in regulated, high-stakes industries like healthcare, finance, and government. Whether it’s refactoring legacy apps, implementing CI/CD, or designing secure cloud architecture, we’re the team clients call when the stakes are high and the problems are complex.
Position Summary
We’re hiring an Account Executive with a partnerships-first mindset, someone who knows how to build pipeline from existing partner relationships and independently create new opportunities when needed.
We have strong partnerships and channel relationships that can be a source of warm introductions but we’re looking for someone who takes ownership of their territory and doesn’t wait for leads to land in their inbox. If partner-sourced pipeline is light, you’ll be responsible for driving pipeline through outbound efforts, referrals, and uncovering new prospects.
You’ll be focused on building relationships, developing target accounts, and closing high-value technical consulting deals. This is a consultative role where your ability to build trust, position value, and navigate complex sales cycles matters more than running a script.
What You’ll Do

• Build and manage your pipeline by activating partner-sourced opportunities and supplementing them with outbound and referral-based outreach.

• Own the full sales cycle from discovery through to proposal, negotiation, and close.

• Conduct account mapping and relationship development across target accounts in your assigned territory.

• Collaborate with marketing and delivery to ensure aligned messaging and quality engagements.

• Navigate complex sales cycles involving multiple technical and executive stakeholders.

• Scope engagements in collaboration with our consultants and engineers to ensure alignment and set clear expectations.

• Regularly review pipeline metrics, log sales activity, and update forecasts in HubSpot to ensure visibility and accuracy.

What You Bring

• 3+ years of B2B sales experience, preferably in technical consulting, custom software development, or professional services.

• A proven ability to generate pipeline independently, even in the absence of high lead volume.

• Experience selling to technical buyers - CTOs, CISOs, Directors of Engineering, especially in regulated environments.

• Strength in relationship-building, listening, and consultative selling.

• Comfortable speaking about DevOps, cloud infrastructure, or software development solutions from a strategic or outcomes-based perspective (without needing deep technical expertise).

• A self-starter mindset with strong ownership over results and a comfort level working in ambiguity.

Nice to Have

• Experience working with channel partners or building pipeline through alliances.

• Familiarity with sales tools like HubSpot, Sales Navigator, Clay, Lemlist, or Instantly.

• Background in or selling into regulated industries like healthcare, finance, or government.

Why Join NextLink Labs

• We’re a technical consulting firm that values clarity, ownership, and outcomes

• Compensation includes a competitive base salary and uncapped commission.

• You’ll earn long-tail commission on any deal you source, even after it’s handed off. As a result, you’re rewarded for initiating valuable relationships.

• Remote-first culture, flexible work schedule, and autonomy to do your best work.

• Healthcare (Medical, Dental, and Vision) and 401k

title: Model Engineer
description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

Model Engineer

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. We train frontier coding agents and scale RL on real user data to make them increasingly effective. We're looking for Research Scientists who can drive effective RL or mid-training research in a small-team setting. You'll own ambiguous, hard research problems end-to-end: forming hypotheses, designing experiments, building the training/eval/data needed to test them, and pushing results into the next model.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Design and run rigorous experiments that turn research ideas into measurable gains in model capability

- Improve data recipes through data quality, deduplication, and mixture experiments

- Define what makes RL data and rewards good, including grader design and preventing reward hacking

- Advance training science, from architecture and scaling experiments to post-training recipes for coding and computer-use agents

- Build evals and targeted tasks that expose model weaknesses and guide where the team invests next

- Partner with engineers to take promising results from small experiments to frontier-scale training runs

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

- Experience writing production-quality code in Python, PyTorch, JAX, Rust, or C++

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

- Able to handle ambiguous research tasks with little guidance, and to own a research direction end to end

- Care an unusual amount about data quality, and can dive into the data when appropriate

- Truth seeking, aiming to learn more about the science than to prove your ideas are correct

- Experience with RL algorithms for language models, scaling laws, or building RL environments and evals

- Experience with distributed training at scale and debugging problems that only show up at scale

- Experience training frontier-scale models

- Strong background in RL and machine learning fundamentals

- An excellent programmer and software engineer, comfortable working across the research stack in Python and PyTorch or JAX

- Hands-on experience training large models, through pretraining, post-training or RL

- A track record of original work in ML, such as new methods or real improvements, shown through research, open source or production impact

- MS or PhD in CS, ML, math, physics or a related field, or equivalent research experience

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

- Onsite role: must be able to work in person at the Palo Alto office

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

Annual Salary:

$160,000 - $250,000 USD

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

title: Deal Desk and Sales Operations Specialist
description:
At TRG, we have been securing better lives for the last 9 years. TRG enables silo elimination and AI in one of the most complex operational sectors in the world of intelligence. Our platforms empower sovereign nations and government entities to combat crime and terror through AI-driven data fusion, analytics and intelligence capabilities. TRG deploys on-premise or air-gapped, is sovereign by design, and is operational within days.
About the role
You are the commercial backbone of our B2G sales teams and the owner of the deal process. Every proposal passes through you before final approval. You build quotes, check contracts and terms, and help sales managers move their deals forward across our three deal types: silo replacement, multi-silo stack consolidation, and project-based analytics displacement, including national-scale programs.
You also run the weekly numbers behind the pipeline, so that leadership and Finance can rely on them. Sales managers own their deals and their CRM records; you check them and follow up.
What you will do
Quotes and pricing

• Build fast, repeatable quotes and proposals with the calculator and templates: silo swap-outs, multi-silo consolidation cases and multi-year structures for larger programs.

• Prepare consolidation cases that compare a customer's existing contracts with a single TRG platform.

• Handle multi-currency pricing, payment terms, and licensing, support and deployment structures; model partner and integrator margins.

• Build proposal templates for the different use cases in the region.

Approvals and contracts

• Give the first approval on every proposal: products, scope, price, payment terms and terms and conditions, checked against the price list, the calculator and company policy. Flag any discount or non-standard term for approval under the approval matrix. Finance, Legal and sales leadership give the final approval.

• Maintain the approval matrix (discounts, payment terms, liability, non-standard terms) and a library of standard terms and approved fallback positions.

• Review contracts, purchase commitments, partner and exclusivity terms with Legal, and flag anything non-standard.

• Run end-user, channel, KYC, sanctions and export-control checks with Legal before a deal goes ahead.

• Prepare the commercial and pricing side of tenders: price sheet, commercial inputs and deadlines, together with the sales manager.

• Respond to every quote and approval request within 2 working hours, or within 2 hours of the start of the next business day if it arrives out of hours.

Deal process

• Own the deal process from first request to signed deal. Track proposals that were sent but have no answer from the customer, remind the sales manager to follow up, and flag stuck deals to the sales manager and the head of department.

• Check that deal records in the CRM (Asana for now) are complete: stage, value, close date and documents (proposal, end-user statement, purchase order). Return gaps to the sales manager, who owns and updates the record.

• Respond to new website requests and route them to the right sales manager under the lead registration process.

• After a deal is signed, check that the full document set is in place for Finance and Delivery.

Sales operations

• Build the weekly pipeline and forecast, including the investor pipeline report. Check every figure and submit it for review and sign-off by the head of department.

• Run daily sales reporting: check that sales managers send their daily summaries, and send the daily summary to leadership.

• Check pipeline data every week against the pipeline rules (stages, close dates, evidence), and follow up with sales managers on gaps and stale deals.

• Report monthly on win rates, discount levels, deal cycle times and margin by region.

• Support the company revenue forecast with Finance, and reconcile renewals with Finance's ARR file.

• Maintain the price list and the proposal calculator with Product and Finance, and administer A

Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.

If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.

The Go To Market (GTM) Performance & Strategy team helps teams turn strategy into consistent execution through targeted coaching, practice, and performance improvement. As a Senior Field Performance Partner, you’ll work with frontline Sales and Channel leaders across US and Canada to diagnose performance gaps, build focused development plans, and use data and AI to help teams improve. Your work will help 1Password’s go-to-market organization perform at its best while advancing our mission to enable a safe, productive digital future.

This is not a traditional enablement role. We don’t believe more training is always the answer. We believe enablement should start with the performance problem, use data and AI to understand what’s happening, and apply the most targeted intervention possible.

You’ll turn those insights into focused enablement plans, use AI to scale individualized practice and coaching, help managers reinforce the right behaviors, and measure whether performance actually changed.

As 1Password continues to scale our partner-led GTM motion, you’ll also help make channel execution part of how our field operates every day. Rather than treating channel as a separate motion or specialist skill, you’ll help managers and teams build the behaviors needed to effectively identify, engage, and sell with partners as part of their everyday work.

Your job isn’t to keep people busy with enablement. It’s to help them perform better.

Across GTM, we’re transforming the way we work with AI. We expect every seller, CSM, and team member to become a power user, using it daily to work smarter and move faster. AI is already embedded in how we operate - from real-time coaching that sharpens how we sell and interact with customers, to surfacing insights that help us anticipate needs - creating more time for meaningful customer engagement. If you’re excited to reshape how you think, make decisions, and drive growth with AI, you’ll feel right at home here.

Expectations of this role
This is a hybrid role. You will be expected to work from 1Password's Toronto/Austin office 3 days per week, with the flexibility to work from the office up to 5 days based on business needs.

What we're looking for:

- 7+ years of experience in a Business-to-Business (B2B) technology go-to-market (GTM) organization across Sales, Cus

title: Localization Quality Controller - Korean - Project-based Freelance Position
description:
Localization quality controllers (LQCs) support FunkyCorp project managers on localization projects. They ensure localized content reads naturally in their native language and meets our high standards. FunkyCorp is looking for dedicated individuals who are passionate about translation, detail-oriented, and motivated by a challenge.
What you’ll do:

• Assist in the creation of a terminology list and style guide that aligns with content strategy and clearly defines target-language-specific rules

• Manage the terminology list and style guide

• Review content that has been translated and proofread ensuring it is:

• Consistent with the terminology list and style guide

• Contextually accurate-some words/sentences may need to be translated differently depending on the context. For example, “subject” can be translated differently in French depending on the context: “sujet”, “objet”, “matière”.

• Free from mistranslations, grammatical errors, spelling mistakes and unnatural sentence structure/phrasing.

• 3+ years of professional experience as a translator from English into your native language

• Professional experience as a Localization quality controller or equivalent.

• Bachelor’s degree or higher in translation, English literature, linguistics, your native language, or similar.

• Must be a native speaker of the target language, with impeccable grammar and spelling

• Is fluent in English (speaking, listening, reading and writing)

• Has significant translation, proofreading and/or quality control experience in the digital field

• Has uninterrupted access to the internet and is able to check and respond to emails regularly

• Strong computer literacy including being comfortable using various task management systems, communication apps and presentation/spreadsheet apps for productivity

The ideal person:

• Has visited or lived in Japan and is knowledgeable about the country and its culture

• Has experience working on a large-scale localization project with multiple counterparts

• Has experience working on travel-related contents

• Has extraordinary attention to detail and problem-solving skills

• Has a flexible schedule.

• Thrives working on fast-paced and challenging projects as part of a dynamic team

Business Analysts at Nubank

As a company at the forefront of the financial revolution in Brazil, Nubank has experienced exponential growth since its inception. To keep your growth path healthy, numerous critical decisions constantly need to be made. Business Analysts are fundamental in the decision process because they must not only be able to deal with large amounts of information and data, but also always think of ways to improve our clients' experience.

It is BA's responsibility to structure the data, analyze it and use the results to test different solutions with the aim of improving Nubank's efficiency.

- Problem solving: ease and creativity to seek solutions to day-to-day challenges and achieve the best results;

About Delinea:
Delinea is the identity security platform that continuously controls what AI agents, humans and machines can do and for how long. It extends privileged access management from the point of access to the moment of action, using just-in-time authorization to reduce standing privilege across on-premises, multi-cloud and short-lived infrastructure, without adding friction for legitimate users. Delinea provides visibility across every identity type, scores the risk each one carries, and preserves the context behind access decisions, making them auditable and defensible. It supports both static and ephemeral access, letting teams apply Zero Standing Privilege where risk demands it without replacing existing infrastructure.
